status.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/lake-powhatan-campground ('Site Open') + the forest's Helene closures list (last updated October 1, 2026; Lake Powhatan not listed) + recreation.gov availability (October 2026 sites Reserved/Available), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Gatehouse open March-November 8am-8pm, off season 10am-5pm. Some loops close in winter: about a third of the site-nights in January 2027 show 'Closed' on recreation.gov.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/lake-powhatan-campground ('This site is open year round', Seasons of Use 'Open year-round', Operational Hours 'Gatehouse is open March-November 8am-8pm, off season 10am-5pm') + recreation.gov availability for January 2027, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service page: single site $37, with electric $46, with electric, sewer and water $52. recreation.gov's off-peak season (Nov 16 to mid-March) charges $35 / $44 / $50. Extra vehicle $5 a day; glamping tents $100 weekdays, $130 weekends.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/lake-powhatan-campground (Fee Site and Info: 'Single Site: $37 per night', 'Single Site with electric hook-up: $46 per night', 'Single Site with electric, sewer, and water hook-ups: $52 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231995/rates (2026 Peak Season 03-21 to 11-15: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 37, STANDARD ELECTRIC 46, RV ELECTRIC 52; Non-Peak 2026-11-16 to 12-31: 35 / 44 / 50) + notice '$5 daily extra vehicle fee', read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/lake-powhatan-campground ('Single Site with electric, sewer, and water hook-ups') + RIDB catalog for 231995 (17 reservable RV ELECTRIC sites with 'Electricity Hookup' 50 or 20/30/50 and Water/Sewer Hookup 'Yes'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 71 bookable sites: 27 standard non-electric, 4 standard electric, 17 RV electric (full hookup) and 23 tent-only, plus 12 glamping tents and 13 staff sites. RV-capable sites list a max vehicle length of 25 to 50 ft (26 at 40 ft); 7 pull-throughs. Four loops.

sites.source: RIDB catalog for 231995 (type/reservable counts, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + recreation.gov availability (71 sites) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231995 ('The shaded, private campsites are organized into four loops', '12 glamping tents'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Ice and firewood sold at the gatehouse.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/lake-powhatan-campground ('Flush toilets and showers in bath house', 'Potable water is available at this site') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231995 (amenities incl. 'Dump Station', 'Showers', 'Flush Toilets', 'Drinking Water'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Run by the concessionaire Naventure for the Forest Service; campground phone (828) 577-7278. Reservations up to 6 months ahead; 14 nights at most in a rolling 30 days. Check in at the gatehouse (winter hours Nov 15-March 24: 10am-5pm; outside them, pick up a map there).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231995 (facility_rules reservationWindow 6 Months, maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days'; notices 'This campground is managed by Naventure', 'Winter Gatehouse Hours (Nov. 15-March 24): 10am-5pm'; is_commercially_managed false) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/lake-powhatan-campground (Contact Name: Naventure, Contact Phone: (828) 577-7278), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Senior/Access discount applies only to the single standard site rate, card holder present.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/lake-powhatan-campground ('Federal Interagency Senior/Access discounts only apply to single standard site rate. Does not apply to any other items or services. Card holder must be present on site to use discount.'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Forest Service page and recreation.gov: open (not on the Helene closures list; 'Site Open'), year-round, run by concessionaire Naventure. Confirmed fees $35 off-peak / $37 peak to $52 full hookup and 50-amp/water/sewer hookups (now manual); added 71 bookable sites to 50 ft with pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/water/dump, 6-month window, 14-night max, senior/access discount on the standard rate. Not stated: FCFS/walk-up, a minimum stay.

Not changed.
Name: the Forest Service page calls it 'Lake Powhatan Campground'; recreation.gov 'LAKE POWHATAN'. Concession-operated on federal land (Naventure); ownership 'federal' is right.
